The failure may be tied to a feature-flag evaluation on the payment path: the dependency breakdown for the same window returns payment span grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat 1.25 and cart span flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean 11.25, matching the ERROR Charge magnitude numerically. The metric cannot associate a flag evaluation with a specific failing request, so this is a lead, not a cause.

Rejected as unsupported by the returned data: that cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, email or the checkout shipping/cart/currency steps were failing in this window. No ERROR status series was returned for cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping or email, payment ERROR was confined to the Charge span, and the cart/currency/product-catalog/shipping spans present in the sampled traces carry only grpc status 0, OK or HTTP 200. This rejection reflects absence of returned ERROR evidence, not proven health of those dependencies.

Human follow-up is warranted on the payment service's card-charge path and on the feature-flag configuration it evaluates, plus on the card token supplied by the load generator, since the only observed error text is a rejected card token while dependencies other than payment show no error tags.
